about: READ-ONLY: can this host open a TCP connection to <ip>:<port>? A LAN/tunnel-side vantage the cluster pod lacks (no CAP_NET_RAW, no route into the WireGuard overlay). First use 2026-09-07: is the WireGuard hub 10.99.0.1 reachable over wg0 (the bastion route into the LAN); also the gateway-vs-ISP question for the 1.1.1.0/24 blackhole. Read-only in the phase-1 sense: a TCP connect, nothing sent, nothing mutated. Runs infra/forge/reach.sh: one line, open (<N>ms) / closed (<reason>) / timeout (4s), exit 0 only when open. IPv4 literal only — no hostname, so the host never resolves a name on a packet's behalf.
